observation.depicts: Dense mossy forest with a translucent moss-textured human figure standing at centre right, a cobblestone path with yellow curb bottom right, a utility pole top right, and a quote box top left.
observation.text_readable: Readable: "Standing on the bare ground, — my head bathed by the blithe air", "I become a transparent eye-ball; I am nothing; I see all", "I am part or parcel of God.", "Parker Jackim Period 2" (small, bottom right).
observation.composition: Full-frame forest; figure sits right of centre, standing on mossy rocks; text box in upper left; cobblestone path and utility pole occupy the right edge and bottom right corner. Nothing cut off except the pole at the edge.
observation.tone_and_contrast: Saturated greens with bright light through the canopy at the top and darker moss shadows; figure is the same green as the moss, so it separates only slightly from the background.
observation.sharpness_and_artifacts: Sharp overall; text box background is blurred with a thin white border; small name label with corner brackets bottom right. Figure edges look cut out. Native file could not be opened directly (too large); viewed a downscaled copy.
observation.scan_first_read: A lush green moss forest with a quote; the ghostlike figure is hard to pick out at thumbnail size.

legend.3: Good: sharp at native size with reasonable headroom
